voices.name: l00
voices.text: If your heart feels heavy, <#0.2#> let me ask you one thing.
voices.caption: If your heart feels heavy, let me ask you one thing.

voices.name: l01
voices.text: Are you sadness? <#0.3#> Or someone feeling sadness?
voices.caption: Are you sadness? Or someone feeling sadness?

voices.name: l02
voices.text: No matter how dark the clouds get, <#0.2#> the sky is never stained.
voices.caption: No matter how dark the clouds get, the sky is never stained.

voices.name: l03
voices.text: Feelings are the clouds. <#0.3#> You are the sky.
voices.caption: Feelings are the clouds. You are the sky.

voices.name: l04
voices.text: Don't push it away. <#0.2#> Just say, oh, I'm sad right now.
voices.caption: Don't push it away. Just say, oh, I'm sad right now.

voices.name: l05
voices.text: The clouds pass. <#0.3#> The sky stays.
voices.caption: The clouds pass. The sky stays.
